t: You're looking at St James's Church, the Church of England parish church of Paddington, at the western end of Sussex Gardens, a long tree-lined avenue just north of Hyde Park. The church was designed by George Edmund Street, a leading figure of the Victorian Gothic Revival, who is perhaps best known for the Royal Courts of Justice on the Strand. It's named for Saint James the Elder, one of the Twelve Apostles and the patron saint of Spain.
